title: Body Fat Scale Trend Break After Travel
dataSources: Oura stress and recovery (`oura:stress`), CPAP therapy sessions (`cpap:session`), oral thermometer readings (`thermometer:reading`), and body-composition scale snapshots (`bodycomp:reading`).
app: Personal health telemetry from Oura, OSCAR CPAP exports, oral thermometer readings, and smart body-composition scales sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bodycomp:reading
| search weight_kg=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(weight_kg) as avg_weight_kg avg(body_fat_pct) as avg_body_fat_pct by _time post_travel
| sort - _time
description: Tracks body-composition trend breaks after travel over time and breaks it out by post-travel flag.
value: Travel often distorts the scale signal, so isolating those days keeps the long trend honest.
implementation: Send body-composition trend breaks after travel events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of body-composition trend breaks after travel by post-travel flag.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how body-composition trend breaks after travel changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
